name: agent-toolkit
description: Reusable engineering skills for project guidance, requirements, technical design, HTML mocks, design systems, screen composition, estimates, implementation prompts, end-to-end app builds, incremental implementation, application demo videos, and narrated explainer videos.

interface.shortDescription: Project guidance, requirements, designs, mocks, design systems, screen composition, estimates, implementation prompts, end-to-end app builds, incremental implementation, and videos
interface.longDescription: Generate agent instruction files, define traceable L1/L2 requirements, create detailed software designs with diagrams, write HTML mocks for every screen and state, extract design systems with verified contrast, map every screen to component-library parts and local UI, estimate effort and track percent complete per design, write end-to-end implementation prompts for features and bug fixes, build a whole app from one idea in a single planned run, deliver changes in thin tested slices, record verified application demos, and build narrated slide-deck videos using twelve bundled engineering skills.
defaultPrompt: Create agent instruction files for a new project.
Define L1 and L2 requirements for my application.
Create HTML mocks for every page, dialog and notification in every state.
Extract the design system from docs/mocks/.
Write docs/screen-composition.md mapping each mock to component-library components.
Estimate effort and percent complete for every detailed design.
Write an implementation prompt for this feature request and open it in Notepad.
Build a complete app from this idea, with mocks, specs, designs and tests.
Implement the next task from the plan in thin, tested, committed slices.
Create a demo video for each executable application in this repository.
Create a narrated video that explains a feature of this repository.
